description: Example topic list for batch generation. Use with: npm run agentic:generate -- --topics "topic 1,topic 2" or place topics in this file for reference.
example_command: npm run agentic:generate -- --topics "AI in healthcare,Space exploration,Climate change solutions,Digital marketing tips,Coding best practices"

with_flags.description: Same topics with GPU and landscape orientation
with_flags.command: npm run agentic:generate -- --gpu --orientation landscape --topics "AI in healthcare,Space exploration"

preview_mode.description: Preview-only (plan stage, no downloads or renders)

parallel_batch.description: Batch with parallel execution (3 concurrent jobs)
parallel_batch.command: npm run agentic:batch:parallel -- --topics "Topic A,Topic B,Topic C,Topic D"
